beats.prompt: Test the washhouse roof with a bucket
beats.result: You wait below. The floor where the records will stand stays dry.

beats.prompt: Fit the latch so the sleeping-room door shuts
beats.result: The woman at the head of the queue closes it herself. A door she cannot close from inside is no use to her.

beats.prompt: Make up the first bed and receive the arrivals
beats.result: A blanket laid on a frame, a cup where a hand reaches: now there is somewhere to put a tired person.

beats.prompt: Separate the public summary from protected accounts
beats.result: Offices and dates go on the public sheet. Private material stays with its speaker or its agreed limits.

beats.prompt: Pare the bowl of a spoon across the grain
beats.result: A curl of wood comes away. Soup would still run out one side.

beats.prompt: Ask where she wants to go when she can leave the practice
beats.line: The coast. I want to see what grows where salt gets into the soil. And before you ask, I have already arranged who will come when Pell needs someone.
beats.result: Mira turns the spoon and shows where to start again.
beats.speaker: Mira

choices.label: Ask her to bring back a plant name
choices.result: She makes no promise about the spelling.

choices.label: Set aside evening time together
choices.result: The coast is still her plan. This evening belongs to both of you.

beats.prompt: Leave the private cupboard shut
beats.result: A broken horn button shows for a moment before the fold closes. Some of Harl belongs to his widow alone.

beats.prompt: Test the alarm from the covered step
beats.result: Nine quick blows bring people to the wrong door. The next test starts in the back sleeping room.

beats.prompt: Check whether the alarm carries to the far bed
beats.result: It is loud enough. The agreed signal must be slow enough to count.

beats.prompt: Sound three blows, pause, then three more
beats.result: This time the watch finds the right door.

beats.prompt: Enter only the shifts the keepers have accepted
beats.result: An empty space stays empty. Someone still has to decide what to do when the next pair of hands goes to bed.

beats.prompt: Take Kael’s own turn at the covered step
beats.result: By the time the next watch arrives the step has gone cold. Someone offers another hour. The resting place is theirs to use.

beats.speaker: Merrow
beats.prompt: Ask about the second refusal entry
beats.line: I kept a duplicate. If anyone ever asked, I wanted to prove I wasn’t the only hand. Yes, sometimes I was. The strongbox is under the old chopping bench. I have one key.
beats.reply: Take the flat key he offers
beats.result: Merrow entrusts the clerk’s key. Edric still holds the inner key.

beats.prompt: Read the notice suspending existing marks
beats.result: “Reverified.” Delay can do a refusal’s work while leaving the refusal column blank.

beats.prompt: Fit Merrow’s flat key in the outer lock
beats.result: One lock opens. Edric still has the other key. The chopping block is older than the iron.

beats.prompt: Work the worn hinge clear of the bolted bench
beats.result: The inner lock holds. The old hinge gives. Inside is a thin volume in faded cloth.

beats.prompt: Compare the duplicate refusal entries
beats.result: A second reason in Merrow’s hand: “Would not assent.” This is a ration duplicate. It supplies neither the old closure order nor a missing witness.

evidence.title: The duplicate refusal book
evidence.text: Dates, amounts and refusals. Some entries say that a household would not assent. The duplicate adds evidence about the grain condition only.

beats.prompt: Move the sack off the lane to the grain scales
beats.result: Now someone can leave with flour without having to pass a witness chair.

beats.prompt: Set the ration book apart from the speaking list
beats.result: A mark here records a measure received. It offers no account of the old gate.

beats.prompt: Leave Elna’s place empty after the hearing
beats.result: Her answer was hers. A quiet chair is an honest part of the hearing.

beats.prompt: Spread the human copies on the dry stone
beats.result: A tally, a receipt and a correction cannot hold the feeling of standing at a gate. They can still show who shut it.

beats.prompt: Wrap the pages before answering the Hart
beats.result: Take what people can bear away with them. Leave room for an answer only this witness can give.

beats.prompt: Lay the households’ requests beside the stones
beats.result: Siv reads her own words with a finger under the line. A keeper offering a shift is not a passenger asking for shelter.

beats.prompt: Place a warm brick away from the ramp
beats.result: There is a dry place for Bracken with an adult. The working ramp is clear for the families.

beats.prompt: Sort serviceable blankets from the mud-stiff ones
beats.result: No one goes back for furniture while the last passengers need shelter.

beats.prompt: Account for people and damaged goods separately
beats.result: A chair is a heavy loss to the person who owns it. It is still counted on a different page from a person.

beats.prompt: Ask Nera what company she wants tonight
beats.line: An evening. It doesn’t have to mean we’ve settled every other evening.
beats.result: The space between you has a purpose too.
beats.speaker: Nera

choices.label: Share the evening meal
choices.result: Two bowls come to the table.

choices.label: Wish her a quiet evening
choices.result: She takes her own bowl and a place near the door.

beats.prompt: Offer Nera a place at the evening meal
beats.line: I’ve counted them. The stores will wait an hour. I can sit for an hour.
beats.result: She takes her own bowl when she leaves.
beats.speaker: Nera

choices.label: Make room at your end of the table
choices.result: She stays until she wants to sleep.

choices.label: Let her choose a quiet place
choices.result: The handover stands either way.

beats.prompt: Test the grey ground beyond the burned stones
beats.result: A voice is gone for good. Human copies survive. The seed will have to be checked after rain.

beats.prompt: Take the dry record packet from the repaired window
beats.result: A home has room for a chair with a back. Carry it sideways and the legs just clear the frame.

beats.prompt: Fit the chair that Siv’s father lost
beats.result: Toma drives the peg while Tor holds the joint. Siv’s father leans back, complains about the angle and stays seated.

scenes.title: Water won’t wait for your anniversary

beats.prompt: Mark the place Bera’s cartwheel sank
beats.result: Bera pushes a switch into the ground and sights past the post.

beats.prompt: Take up the crooked board and give the water a way out
beats.result: The ditch follows the ground. Bera says the ground could stand to improve itself.

scenes.title: The judge is eating her second loaf

beats.prompt: Offer Vale the next place at the slate
beats.line: “You couldn’t have gone through the other piece.” Pell shakes her head. “Under it.” Vale’s appeal reaches the girl with the bread and goes no further. She turns to you. “One round with the rules we started with?”
beats.result: Merrow has begun to count the pieces. He will regret taking sides.
beats.speaker: Vale

choices.label: Play a round of Three Marks with Vale
choices.result: The slate goes back to the children. Pell considers the arrangement between the grown-ups a local variation.

choices.label: Watch the children try Merrow’s patience
choices.result: He explains his objection to a judge who has just finished her bread. The corner piece goes under again.

scenes.title: Three houses are still too few

beats.prompt: Read the description that could identify three families
beats.result: The road, the winter and the trade would narrow it to three doors. Elna taps the line with her nail.

beats.prompt: Leave the identifying description off the wall copy
beats.result: The reference stays in the packet with its access terms. The public page can still say what the order did.

beats.prompt: Offer to take the last clean copy to the dry shelf
beats.line: I kept that pear through the whole argument. By the time we got outside it was a brown handful. I would like to eat this one sitting down.
beats.result: Vale closes the shutters on the copying bench.
beats.speaker: Vale

choices.label: Take the packet and leave her a quiet table
choices.result: She slides an uneaten slice across the board. It tastes of a perfectly ordinary pear.

choices.label: Sit with her while the ink dries
choices.result: Vale puts her warm hand over Kael’s wrist and turns it palm up. The ink can take as long as it likes.

scenes.title: The second half of the watch

beats.prompt: Take the lamp round the kitchen wall
beats.result: At the back door the light reaches the latch. At the privy turn your shadow falls across it.

beats.prompt: Hang the relief lamp where the next watcher can find it
beats.result: Anwen stays on the bench until she can see the next lamp moving. Then, for once, she goes to bed.

beats.prompt: Hold the empty measure while a family fills it
beats.result: The woman tips the grain into her folded apron. Her boy licks a kernel and spits it back.

beats.prompt: Leave the statement column to its owner
beats.line: The woman watches the pen. “My father was there. He has asked me to say nothing here.” The next sack is already on the bench.
beats.result: She carries the grain away.
beats.speaker: Household carrier

choices.label: Mark only the weight
choices.result: Merrow records the measure. The testimony column stays blank.

choices.label: Offer her a separate private page
choices.result: She leaves the page untouched. Vale takes it off the grain bench before the next family arrives.

beats.prompt: Kneel beside the spoke tied with wool
beats.result: A man under the wheel asks for a tool. Another hand holds the spoke still. Nobody in the queue yet knows they will spend their last afternoon here.

beats.prompt: Walk beside the child with the saucepan
beats.result: The rim taps her knee. A father carries his son standing on his boots. Someone calls “Avel” and three people turn.

beats.prompt: Stay until the keeper draws the bar
beats.result: The keepers asked for concealment without bloodshed. The gate closes on the people already on the road. Halvern refuses the command and his men take hold of him.

beats.prompt: Choose what to take from the witness
beats.line: Vale has left space between the words spoken at the gate and what she thinks she saw. The Hart waits.
beats.result: Vale closes the packet.
beats.speaker: Vale

choices.label: Ask about the escort eight years ago
choices.result: “I was not there.” Nera can choose to speak about her road. Nothing the Hart shows fills that gap.

choices.label: Ask Vale to distinguish sight from testimony
choices.result: She circles the name she heard and leaves a question beside the face she thought she recognized.

choices.label: Keep the last question to yourself
choices.result: You let the animal stand in the grass. Vale does not fill the space for you.

beats.prompt: Unroll the damp sleeve around the stores sheet
beats.result: The line says meal. There is bran in the stitching of the sack. Two bundles of blankets have the same chalk mark.

beats.prompt: Separate the goods you can identify from the missing fittings
beats.result: Vale initials the correction. The iron fittings stay unaccounted for. Merrow spells out the stores abbreviation, for anyone who can read.

beats.prompt: Ask about Bram’s left gloves
beats.line: “Thirty-seven. He said thirty-seven. I never counted.” Rook catches you smiling. “I counted what he owed.”
beats.result: Rook marks the dry shelves on the wagon sheet. The storage charge is zero.
beats.speaker: Rook

beats.prompt: Take one end of the new arrivals’ bedding
beats.result: The pot lid bangs on its string. Siv has already taken the passenger’s arm. At your end the bedding is heavier than it looks.

beats.prompt: Turn sideways together through the freight door
beats.result: You set it down inside. The last people at the table pass their bowls along and make room for two more.

beats.prompt: Leave the locum’s roster beside the medicine chest
beats.result: Three names cover the herb beds and sick calls. Mira paid her coast deposit out of her own work. Nothing here gives anyone the key to her upstairs room.

beats.prompt: Exchange the used jars at the village well
beats.result: Eggs for one visit, a mended cloth for another. There is still an empty place in the rack for the patient who could pay nothing.

beats.prompt: Turn the red cord until the brass catches the light
beats.result: The cord has faded. Beneath the black bird the letters remain. AVEL.

beats.prompt: Tuck the traveler’s wrapping away
beats.result: Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Oren. The three graves have different patches of sun. You stay until the shadow clears the smallest.

scenes.title: What the kitchen guard asked for

beats.prompt: Set water within reach of the kitchen guard
beats.result: His brother has a claim on the grain store. He wants to know whether that claim disappears with the book.

beats.prompt: Leave the delivery hours beside the covered jar
beats.result: The public hours are enough. His brother’s name goes on neither the packet nor a list of witnesses.
